self_assessment: Implemented a good-faith, from-scratch reimplementation of the requested handler-execution redesign (PlayIterator IteratingStates.HANDLERS phase, HostState fields, PlayIterator.host_states/get_state_for_host/clear_host_errors, Block.get_tasks, Handler.remove_host, force_handlers-aware Play.compile(), flush_handlers 'when' support, meta-as-handler with flush_handlers rejected) and wired it into the linear strategy so handler flushes go through the iterator in lockstep and respect serial batching; verified via the full existing unit test suite (all green) plus several live ansible-playbook smoke runs (notify+flush+serial, force_handlers after an all-hosts failure, when-gated flush_handlers, meta:noop as a handler, any_errors_fatal) that surfaced and fixed three real bugs along the way (an early-return that skipped force_handlers, a stale-notification double-run of meta-action handlers, and a run_once short-circuit that broke per-host flush dispatch), but I had no access to the actual gold patch or the hidden SWE-bench Pro test set, so full behavioral parity with the graded tests is unverified and partial credit is likely rather than a full pass.
